zh.title: 英國法院裁定新創航空 Global Airlines 進入強制清算程序
zh.summary: 英國法院裁定 Global Airlines 強制清算；該公司至今未取得營運許可證。
body: 根據官方紀錄，英國破產與公司法院（Insolvency and Companies Court）已裁定計畫營運空中巴士（Airbus）A380 客機的新創航空公司 Global Airlines 進入強制清算程序。英國官方公報《The Gazette》於 2026 年 11 月 12 日發布正式公告，證實法院已於 11 月 4 日頒布「清算令」（Winding-Up Order），此項裁決源自 2026 年 5 月向英國法院提出的清算申請。

在過去幾個月中，破產與公司法院針對該清算申請舉行了多場聽證會，最近一次聽證會於 2026 年 10 月舉行。在此案中，Global Airlines 前任公司董事 Tom Stokely 與 Prashant Uttamchandani 也以支持債權人的身份加入訴訟，並由 Katten Muchin Rosenman 律師事務所代表出庭。根據英國政府規定，法院頒布清算令後，將由清算官（Official Receiver）負責接管並處置公司資產，公司銀行帳戶通常會被凍結。
Global Airlines 自 2021 年起宣佈計畫籌建以空中巴士 A380 機隊為主的跨大西洋航空公司，因而備受航空業關注。然而，這家英國新創公司始終未取得自身的航空營運許可證（Air Operator Certificate, AOC）。在 2025 年 5 月，該公司僅透過與 Hi Fly Malta 合作，以濕租（wet-lease）模式短暫營運了數班往返英國與紐約之間的航班。
目前 Global Airlines 旗下唯一的空中巴士 A380 客機（國籍標誌及登記號碼：9H-GLOBL），自 2025 年 7 月起便一直封存於法國塔布（Tarbes）。儘管英國公司註冊處（Companies House）網站上 Global Airlines 仍顯示為活躍公司，且創辦人 James Asquith 等人仍登記為活躍董事，但其最新財務帳目聲明已被標註為逾期。
根據歷史紀錄，Global Airlines 於 2026 年 5 月首次遭到債權人提出清算申請。雖然創辦人 James Asquith 曾於 2026 年 6 月表示計畫在 2026 年底前讓該架 A380 重返天空並評估開航馬爾地夫航線，但隨著法院頒布強制清算令，該公司的營運前景已面臨嚴重不確定性。航空新聞媒體 AeroTime 已向 Global Airlines 尋求回應。

en.title: UK court orders compulsory liquidation for A380 startup Global Airlines
en.summary: UK court orders compulsory liquidation for Global Airlines after creditors petition to wind up company.
body: According to official records, the Insolvency and Companies Court in the United Kingdom has ordered Airbus A380 startup Global Airlines into compulsory liquidation. The Official Public Record, The Gazette, published a formal notice on November 12, 2026, confirming that the court granted a Winding-Up Order on November 4, 2026. This ruling followed a Petition to Wind Up originally filed with the UK court in May 2026.

Over the past several months, the Insolvency and Companies Court held multiple hearings regarding the liquidation petition, with the most recent hearing taking place in October 2026. Former Global Airlines directors Tom Stokely and Prashant Uttamchandani joined the case as supporting creditors, represented by law firm Katten Muchin Rosenman. Under UK government guidelines, an officer known as the Official Receiver takes charge of winding up the company, freezing bank accounts and liquidating assets to satisfy debts.

Founded with plans to launch transatlantic services using a fleet of Airbus A380s, Global Airlines had attracted industry attention since 2021. However, the British startup never secured its own Air Operator Certificate. In May 2025, the company operated only a handful of flights between the UK and New York on a wet-lease arrangement with Hi Fly Malta.

The company's sole Airbus A380 aircraft, registered 9H-GLOBL, has remained in long-term storage in Tarbes, France, since July 2025. Although Global Airlines is still listed as an active company on the Companies House registry with founder James Asquith as an active director, its latest financial accounts statement is currently marked as overdue.

According to archive records, Global Airlines previously faced a liquidation petition filed by creditors in May 2026. Although founder James Asquith outlined plans in June 2026 to return the A380 to service before the end of 2026 and evaluate routes to the Maldives, the court's compulsory liquidation order places the company's future in severe doubt. Aviation news outlet AeroTime has contacted Global Airlines for comment.
